category_title: Students with persistent challenging behavior referred for individualized support
scenario_title: Independent work in math evoking escape-maintained behavior
minimal_context: The student is sitting at their desk during independent work time to complete a math worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start working on your independent math worksheet. You need to complete the first five problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts head down on desk) I don't want to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish your work. Just try the first one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves seat without permission) No, I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down and look at your math paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shouts) I said I'm not doing it! (Rips the math worksheet and throws it on the floor)

task.content: Engaging in academic tasks during independent work in math

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Interaction with instructional demands in the classroom setting that may evoke escape-maintained challenging behavior
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: putting head down on desk; leaving seat without permission; damaging instructional materials
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: avoidance or termination of instructional demands
